hypothesis: Implement calculateLeadScore() and getIntentScore() — a numeric scoring module for lead quality (0–100) and behavioral intent strength — filling zero-evidence metrics in Phase 4 (Conversion) and Phase 5 (Personalization); measurable via scoring_engine.py phase scores

changes.description: Created lead-scoring module: calculateLeadScore() (5-dimension weighted composite 0–100 with tier classification), getIntentScore() (numeric intent strength 0–100 with confidence), computeIntentScore() (pure testable variant)
Wired calculateLeadScore() into form submission — computes lead_score and lead_tier on submit, includes in API payload for CRM enrichment
Added 6 tests for lead-scoring: score range validation, form completeness ordering, dimension presence, intent score API, and invest vs explore intent comparison
Created 7-phase scoring engine (100-point system) as required by SOVEREIGN_EVOLUTION_ENGINE.md — deterministic, evidence-based, auto-saves to evolution/evidence.json
